posts.title: Manifesto?
posts.description: It does not matter why I am here because I know right from wrong and I know what love is. I am an animal and animals do not think about heaven and so, should I? Things exist and there is a truth about them but we have no way of finding it out. The purpose of life is to enjoy living.

posts.description: To have a mentor and to be radically independent are mutually exclusive. One must choose
